citations.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 2012, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, ISBN 9787552800692
citations.field: 月部 entry; printed p. 618; PDF p. 631; supplied original scan visually inspected
citations.text: The 月 entry calls the graph pictographic and says its early form resembles a half moon, representing the moon. It reports occasional confusion with 夕, continuity through bronze forms, and graphic change by small-seal script. It cites the eclipse inscription 《合集》11485, relates calendar-month use to the moon’s waxing and waning, and mentions an extended ‘time’ sense. The scan shows the 月 entry ending before the next headword 朔.
